categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of large and medium-sized high-end equipment components. Its main product categories include oil and gas equipment forgings, wind power equipment forgings, mechanical equipment forgings, and other forgings. These products serve industries such as oil and gas extraction, wind power, mechanical equipment, shipbuilding, and nuclear power.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced forging technologies including free forging and ring forging, supported by over 100 sets of advanced equipment such as CNC ring rolling machines, hydraulic forging presses, and air hammers. It has full-process production capabilities from material development to precision machining, heat treatment, welding, and assembly. The company emphasizes technological innovation, automation, and digital transformation to enhance product quality and manufacturing efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global equipment manufacturers in the oil and gas, wind power, mechanical equipment, shipbuilding, and nuclear power sectors. The company serves upstream oil and gas equipment manufacturers and wind turbine component producers, with customers requiring high-performance, customized forgings. Major markets include domestic China and international regions, with a focus on expanding overseas wind power markets under initiatives like the Belt and Road.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities in Zhangjiagang City. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Singapore to support international trade and market expansion. Its sales cover domestic markets and overseas markets including the Middle East, Southeast Asia, South America, and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly as an upstream and midstream supplier in the equipment manufacturing supply chain, producing critical forged components for downstream equipment assemblers and end users in oil and gas, wind power, and other heavy industries. It provides customized forgings that are essential inputs for high-end equipment manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on innovation in forging technologies and product upgrades, emphasizing automation and intelligent manufacturing. R&D efforts target improving product strength, toughness, corrosion resistance, and performance under harsh conditions, especially for deepwater oil and gas and wind power applications. The company collaborates with research institutions and universities to maintain industry-leading technology and expand into downstream component and assembly markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of forged components and related processing services to industrial customers. The company operates a direct sales model, with revenue recognized at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance. It also generates income from scrap material sales and processing fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer with comprehensive certifications and advanced capabilities, competing with other forging suppliers in China and internationally. It holds certifications from major global classification societies and API standards, enabling access to high-end equipment supply chains. Competitive pressures include price competition and industry consolidation, especially in wind power forgings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.34 billion, representing a 6.25% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 33.35 million, a decline of 40.24% due to pricing pressures and increased costs. The company has total assets of about RMB 2.36 billion and equity of RMB 1.53 billion, with a workforce of 766 employees. It shows steady revenue growth but faces margin compression.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, customized forging solutions with stable performance and comprehensive certifications as its core value proposition. It differentiates through advanced manufacturing technology, full-process capabilities, and strong R&D to meet stringent requirements of harsh environments in oil and gas and wind power sectors. Its ability to deliver reliable, high-performance components supports long-term customer relationships and market expansion.
